description: Predicción Marítima is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agencia Estatal de Meteorología. Weather conditions for the high seas and coastal areas adapted to the needs of users are presented. In addition to the prediction in text format, more friendly, graphic information is presented with wind maps and wave height with image animation. Coverage: Agencia Estatal de Meteorología. The portal shows the English title as "Maritime Prediction" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agencia Estatal de Meteorología. Its keywords include costera, alta mar, Predicción, AEMET, marítima. The listing shows 2015-12-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.aemet.es/es/nota_legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
